g_join_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Accessories'

g_join_02.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Allegra K'

g_join_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN users u ON u.id = oi.user_id WHERE u.country = 'Brasil'

g_join_04.sql: SELECT AVG(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN users u ON u.id = oi.user_id WHERE u.gender = 'M'

g_join_05.sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(p.retail_price) FROM products p JOIN distribution_centers d ON d.id = p.distribution_center_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

g_date_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE delivered_at >= '2023-01-01' AND delivered_at < '2023-04-01'

g_date_02.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE created_at >= '2022-12-01' AND created_at < '2023-01-01'

g_date_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE returned_at >= '2023-01-01' AND returned_at < '2024-01-01'

g_date_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= '2023-07-01'

g_date_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2022-06-01' AND created_at < '2022-07-01'

g_biz_01.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Returned') / COUNT(*) FROM orders

g_biz_02.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Cancelled') / COUNT(*) FROM orders

g_biz_03.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'purchase'

g_biz_04.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete' AND p.department = 'Men'

g_biz_05.sql: SELECT AVG(oi.sale_price - p.cost) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete'

g_empty_01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE num_of_item > 10

g_empty_02.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE country = 'Atlantis'

g_empty_03.sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE retail_price > 5000

g_empty_04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE browser = 'Netscape'

g_empty_05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE sale_price < 0

g_agg_01.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY country ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

g_agg_02.sql: SELECT AVG(o.num_of_item) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.age < 25

g_agg_03.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM order_items GROUP BY status ORDER BY 1

g_agg_04.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 3

g_agg_05.sql: SELECT MIN(age) FROM users WHERE gender = 'F'

g_agg_06.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) t

g_agg_07.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE browser = 'Chrome') / COUNT(*) FROM events

g_agg_08.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at)::int FROM order_items WHERE created_at >= '2023-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(sale_price) DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

g_agg_09.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) FROM events e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE u.country = 'Germany'

g_agg_10.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE retail_price > 100
